values.note: Pioneer Campground: 30 single-family sites with graveled parking spurs, concrete picnic tables, fire rings and a utility table, plus one group site. Recreation.gov per-site lengths run 33-74 ft (most 40-55 ft); 3 pull-throughs (sites 02, 08, 14 at 73, 74 and 66 ft), the rest back-in. The 18 less-developed dispersed sites around the reservoir are separate.

note: Manti-La Sal NF (Moab RD) recreation area in Colorado at Buckeye Reservoir, ~7,600 ft among ponderosa pine on the east side of the La Sal Mountains. About 13 mi of winding gravel (FR 0371) from Paradox; follow the FS route, since GPS apps send drivers onto 4WD roads or to locked private gates, and the Upper Two Mile Road alternative is very muddy or impassable when wet. Pioneer Campground is on the reservoir's north side. The reservoir is irrigation storage and can be drained completely in low-water years. --Claude

Lakeview (stored) - possible lakefront upgrade, re-audit lead, waterfront not changed: the note says the Pioneer sites 'sit back from the water', but on imagery (reservoir partly drawn down) sites 08 and 11-15 on the campground's south edge are ~20-40 m from the bank across open, bare ground, and the western sites (01-07) ~30-60 m with scattered pines. The irrigation drawdown caveat (reservoir 'could be drained completely' in low-water years) applies to any upgrade.

Road (criteria check, no problem found): access is ~13 mi of winding gravel FR 0371 from Paradox; the 4WD mention is only a warning that GPS apps route people onto 4WD roads or locked private gates. The FS best route is not described as 4WD. The alternative (Upper Two Mile Road, FR 0208) is 'very muddy or impassable when wet'.
Max length: 74 ft is site 08 (pull-through) in the rec.gov catalog, not a placeholder value; single sites run 33-74 ft, so every one takes a 23-ft rig. The FS page states no maximum.
Pin 38.44531,-109.04384 is 51 m from the centroid of the 31 catalogued site points (38.44556,-109.04335). OK. The group site sits apart, across the inlet to the southeast (38.44200,-109.03759).

Off-season: recreation.gov carries 'First-come, First-served Season' walk-in rates ($15) for Jan 1 - May 14 and Oct 1 - Dec 31, but the FS page says the area is typically open mid-May to September; no fcfs value recorded.
